objectives.title: Liability and Remedy Exclusions
objectives.description: Terms that exclude or limit the imposing party's liability for its own wrongdoing, or that exclude the other party's remedies or the imposing party's liability for breach of its obligations.
criteria: Clauses excluding or limiting the imposing party's liability for intentional acts.
Clauses excluding or limiting the imposing party's liability for gross negligence.
Clauses excluding the remedies available to the other party in the case of the imposing party's nonperformance.
Clauses excluding the imposing party's liability in the case of a breach of its own contractual obligations.

objectives.title: Presumed Unfair Remedy and Liability Limitations
objectives.description: Terms that inappropriately limit the other party's remedies or the imposing party's liability without outright excluding them, or that extend the other party's own liability.
criteria: Clauses inappropriately limiting the remedies available to the other party in the case of the imposing party's nonperformance.
Clauses inappropriately limiting the imposing party's liability in the case of a breach of its obligations.
Clauses extending the liability of the party upon whom the term was unilaterally imposed.

objectives.title: Contract Interpretation Discretion
objectives.description: Terms reserving to the imposing party sole authority to determine data conformity or to interpret contractual terms.
criteria: Clauses reserving to the imposing party sole authority to determine whether the data supplied conform to the contract.
Clauses reserving to the imposing party sole authority to interpret contractual terms.

objectives.title: Customer Data Access Rights
objectives.description: Terms establishing the customer right to use generated data.
criteria: Provisions permitting customer access to generated data.
Provisions permitting customer use of generated data.
Provisions securing customer exploitation of data value.

objectives.title: Data Copy Retrieval
objectives.description: Terms setting timelines for retrieving copies of generated data.
criteria: Provisions governing customer retrieval of data copies during the contract term.
Provisions governing customer retrieval of data copies following contract termination.
Provisions specifying reasonable timeframes for post-termination data collection.

objectives.title: Contract Termination Periods
objectives.description: Terms governing the customer's ability to terminate the agreement within a reasonable period and restricting the provider from terminating at unreasonably short notice.
criteria: Provisions allowing the customer to terminate the agreement within a reasonable period.
Provisions preventing the provider from terminating the contract at unreasonably short notice.
Provisions accounting for the customer's ability to switch to an alternative service before provider-initiated termination takes effect.
Provisions accounting for the financial detriment caused by provider-initiated termination.

objectives.title: Unilateral Contract Modifications
objectives.description: Terms specifying provider rights to adjust contractual conditions.
criteria: Provisions specifying valid reasons for unilateral price changes.
Provisions specifying valid reasons for unilateral data specification changes.
Provisions granting customer termination rights upon unilateral modifications.
Provisions requiring advance notice periods for contractual variations.

objectives.title: Detrimental Data Exploitation Safeguards
objectives.description: Terms restricting detrimental provider exploitation of customer proprietary data.
criteria: Provisions restricting provider access to customer trade secrets.
Provisions restricting provider utilization of customer commercially sensitive data.
Provisions governing protection of customer intellectual property.
